summary: Dental, dermatology and cosmetic services under one roof is a strength, but a menu typo, repeated blocks and no booking form appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The Book Consultation button appears about five times but sends people to a contact page, with no form or time slots, and the phone links are written with spaces.
findings.cost: Patients ready to book face extra steps and some will leave.
findings.fix: A booking form with time slots on the page.

findings.problem: The menu shows About Us three times in one label, and Your Health, Our Priority appears twice.
findings.cost: Copy errors and repeated blocks make a medical centre look careless.
findings.fix: A clean menu and tidy sections.

findings.problem: A testimonial reads Mity the laser tech and nice is really good, and the doctor list shows only dentists although dermatology is promoted.
findings.cost: Weak reviews and a mismatch between services and doctors reduce trust.
findings.fix: Edited, named reviews and a full doctor list.

findings.problem: Find Us Easily says use the map but shows no map, address or hours, and 4.8 (300+) Reviews has no source.
findings.cost: Patients cannot find you or verify your rating.
findings.fix: A map with address and hours, and a linked review source.

redesign: A booking form with time slots and WhatsApp.
A clean menu, a map with hours and tidy sections.
Named reviews and a complete doctor list.
